name: Cometary-Scree
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in an ancient meteor crater. Travelers navigate by an orbital debris ring and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.

Standing still, you feel the temperate air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Something scrubbed this biosphere clean within a geological instant. The rocks remember it as a thin black line.
Nothing about the radiation hotspot appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
There is money in solar potential here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
